description: Recorder for Grain Engine MK2, placed immediately to the right of it, that captures incoming audio to a WAV file and hands it to one of that module's five sample slots

params.text: Starts recording the incoming audio; pressing it while a recording is running stops that one instead
Stops the recording, saves it to disk and loads it into the chosen sample slot of Grain Engine MK2
Picks which of the five sample slots in Grain Engine MK2 receives the recording

inputs.text: A rising edge starts recording the incoming audio
A rising edge stops the recording, saves it and loads it into the chosen sample slot
The left channel of the audio to record
The right channel of the audio to record
Adds to the sample slot choice, a volt per slot

outputs.text: The left input passed through unchanged
The right input passed through unchanged

notes: recordings are written as WAV files in Rack's user folder and are named after this module and the slot they were sent to
nothing is recorded and nothing passes through unless Grain Engine MK2 is the module immediately to the left

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
